doc.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks her on behalf of Hamilton College and they say goodbye.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well they certainly have you working this weekend, and singing at what, 9:30 AM or something. So I think you pulled it off pretty well, and I want to — on behalf of Hamilton College I want to thank you for joining us.
Well thank you. I guess after enough arm twisting it was my pleasure. Maybe I’ll visit the campus some day.
That would be a pleasure, too. We’re about five hours from New York.
How far are you from here?
About four and a half. So we’re right in between. When you come you can sit and watch your interview.
Or all these other ones too. These sound interesting. Well I’m glad that you’re doing what you’re doing, and I hope you get a lot more people.
Thank you, Monk. © Fillius Jazz Archive -12-
